title: Outsiders #1 Omega Cover DC Comics November 1993 Mike W. Barr Paul Pelletier
condition_description: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
description:
Outsiders #1 (November 1993), DC Comics - Omega edition (the series launched with Alpha and Omega versions of #1). Written by Mike W. Barr, art by Paul Pelletier and Robert Campanella, cover by Travis Charest. $1.75 cover price.

Back cover: Demolition Man (Stallone / Snipes) movie ad.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
